family_title_en: Complete the sentence with the affixed word

stages.ix_title: Complete the sentence with the affixed word

what_to_do.en: Tap the word with the ending or beginning that fits.
what_to_do.ko: 알맞은 끝이나 시작이 붙은 말을 누르세요.

stages.choice_rule: Build four unique whole-word choices and one right answer. The right word has a real affix and is the last word of the sentence: do not end the stem with a period, and do not put punctuation on a choice. A period may close an earlier sentence. Wrong choices are the base word, the same base with the wrong affix, or one close neighbor. The stem alone must make every wrong choice untrue or ungrammatical. Do not use a blank or an underscore.

gold_items.stem: The kids should cross the street
My dog is big, but his dog is even
She is full of help. We call her
She lost her dog and is not happy. She is
Look at the three frogs. This one is the

roots: Give four whole words. Exactly one is the affixed word that ends the sentence and makes it true.
Wrong choices are the base word, the same base with the wrong affix, or one close neighbor. Never a phoneme, a letter name, or a symbol.
Stem words must come from the roots list, the allowed extra words, or the NAME token. Do not write a blank or an underscore.
If two choices could finish the stem, the item is wrong. Rewrite until only one choice is grammatical and true.
Tier 1 clues are loud and the wrong endings are obvious. Tier 3 choices differ by one affix, such as er versus est or happy versus unhappy.
Use kid topics only: school, home, food, pets, play, family, and weather. No brands. When a child is named, use the NAME token once, never a real name.
The right word must show one of these affixes: ed, ing, s, es, er, est, ly, ful, less, un, or re. Do not use an irregular form such as swam as the answer.
Set explain_key to one of ing_now, ed_past, plural_s, verb_s, ly_how, er_more, est_most, ful_of, less_without, un_not, or re_again.
The stem alone must be enough to answer. Do not describe a picture. Do not invent mp3 or wav files. If media is used, add one lemma of a noun already in the stem.

tier_rules.1: Stems of four to six words with one loud clue. Use are with ing, yesterday with ed, or a number more than one with s. Wrong choices are the base word or an ending that cannot fit.
tier_rules.2: Stems of six to nine words. Use ly, er, or ful. A clue such as even, should, or full of blocks the other forms. Wrong choices are the base, a wrong affix, or one neighbor.
tier_rules.3: Stems of eight to ten words. Include a near miss on the same base, such as er versus est or happy versus unhappy. Every other wrong choice must be ungrammatical or contradicted by the stem.

ing_now.en: This is happening now, so the word ends with ing.
ing_now.ko: 지금 일어나고 있으므로 말은 ing로 끝납니다.

ed_past.en: This already happened, so the word ends with ed.
ed_past.ko: 이미 일어난 일이므로 말은 ed로 끝납니다.

plural_s.en: The number is more than one, so the word ends with s.
plural_s.ko: 수가 하나보다 많으므로 말은 s로 끝납니다.

verb_s.en: He, she, or it does the action now, so the verb ends with s.
verb_s.ko: 한 사람이나 한 동물이 지금 하면 동사는 s로 끝납니다.

ly_how.en: The word tells how an action happens, so it ends with ly.
ly_how.ko: 어떻게 하는지를 나타내므로 말은 ly로 끝납니다.

er_more.en: Two things are compared, so the word ends with er.

est_most.en: Three or more are compared, so the word ends with est.
est_most.ko: 셋 이상을 비교하므로 말은 est로 끝납니다.

ful_of.en: Ful at the end means full of. The base tells what it is full of.
ful_of.ko: 끝에 붙은 ful은 가득함을 뜻합니다. 기본 말이 무엇으로 가득한지 알려 줍니다.

less_without.en: Less at the end means without. The base tells what is missing.
less_without.ko: 끝에 붙은 less는 없음을 뜻합니다. 기본 말은 없는 것을 알려 줍니다.

un_not.en: Un at the beginning means not. The word is the opposite.
un_not.ko: 앞에 붙은 un은 아님을 뜻합니다. 그 말은 반대 뜻입니다.

re_again.en: Re at the beginning means again. The action happens one more time.
re_again.ko: 앞에 붙은 re는 다시를 뜻합니다. 그 일이 한 번 더 일어납니다.
